theme_central: Building a just society: from the family (orphans, women, inheritance) to the community (obedience, hypocrisy) and on to the whole of humanity.
sources_note: 3-part structure following Amin Ahsan Islahi's coherence-based approach, taken up by imamghazali.org (Thematic Explanation); corroborated by islamophile.org for the detail of 1-43.

branches.title: Foundations of a just society
branches.resume: From the common origin of humanity to the family: orphans, inheritance, marriage, kindness.

children.t: Common origin of humanity (Adam and Hawwa)
Rights of orphans, laws of inheritance
Marriage laws, the dowry, resolving marital conflicts
Call to kindness toward parents, neighbours and the poor

branches.title: Challenges to a just society
branches.resume: Deviations of the People of the Book, obedience to legitimate authority, rules of combat, warning against hypocrites.

children.t: Deviations of the People of the Book
Obedience to those in authority, justice in judgment
Defensive fighting, the prayer of fear (salat al-khawf)

branches.title: Fulfilment of a just society
branches.resume: Return to justice toward women and orphans, call to be upholders of justice, final clarifications.

children.t: Return to justice toward women and orphans
Call to be upholders of justice, warning against hypocrisy
Theological clarifications addressed to the People of the Book
The chain of prophets, the true status of Aissa (Jesus)
